title: Agent command registry: full RPC method surface over the editor
description: Depends on 0613-agent-bridge-mvp-protocol-package-vite-ws-relay-. Implement the full MVP command surface from docs/19-agent-interface.md §Command surface in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts: document (doc.load, doc.properties.set, history.undo/redo/depth), stage & selection (stage.addShape/addText/placeInstance/update/remove/arrange/group/ungroup, selection.get/set/clear/all, view.set, tool.select), timeline (layer CRUD, insertFrame/insertKeyframe/insertBlankKeyframe/removeFrame, setFrameLabel, setTween, gotoFrame, playback.play/stop), code (script.get/set/check/list — script.set runs compileScript in check mode and returns diagnostics without blocking the write), library (list, createSymbol, convertToSymbol, rename, remove), output & escape hatches (jsfl.run, stage.screenshot, publish.swf, file.saveFla/loadFla via in-memory FileIO). Rules: every handler goes through the shared command layer (@flash/core mutations + pushDoc + Shell selection/view setters) — never bypass history. Colors are #RRGGBB(AA) strings at the protocol boundary; frame indices 0-based; mutating results include rev; errors are actionable (name the bad param, include valid alternatives like known layerIds in error.data). Extract the Shell's __flashTest closures into a shared module so the test bridge and the registry share one implementation per command and cannot drift. Tests: unit tests per method group against @flash/core fixtures + extend the e2e bridge spec to cover at least one mutate→doc.get assert round-trip per domain.
